Complete provisional timing is not measured processing-element occupancy. Detailed trials record parent/library identities, actual pass order, transformed/emitted hashes, numeric results, timing scope/domain and decision. Mechanisms not investigated here remain untried; the catalogue is not a mandatory checklist.

Continued integration: `gemmini_copy_loops.py` consumes the existing verified column plan and ordinary shared host read/write/loop builder for bounded lanes. Existing scalar-pointwise unroll and contiguous-suffix copy were tried/rejected for arbitrary signed-stride integer traversal (evidence `artifacts/column-copy-short/report.json`). `gemmini_dense_short_policy.py` and its actual `emit_dense` hook consume the existing checked panel pipeline with batched readout/epoch law; opt-in, default off after the matched global JM regression (`artifacts/dense-short-policy/matched-evidence.json`). These are consumed production alternatives, not checking-only schedules.
